proposal.description: JCM1270 explicitly weighs44g BD-Difco Columbia blood agar base, then separately adds water and sheep blood. Manufacturer manual distinguishes Difco44g/L base from BBL42.5g/L and EH39g/L variants. This source-qualified owner denotes the dry Difco input; it does not reuse MICRO536 whose definition transcribes the BBL formulation. Typical constituent names are retained without historical lot or dry-mass-ratio claims. Recovered manufacturer-authored BD Difco & BBL Manual, second edition 2009, printed p158 (PDF page170), hosted by NMSU. It directs suspension of44g powder in1L purified water. Those are manufacturer preparation/formula statements, not dry-product mass fractions, final yield, or an identified historical JCM lot. The same page separately gives BBL42.5g (including13.5g agar, meat peptic digest and heart pancreatic digest) and DifcoEH39g (including12g agar and different nutrient inputs).
